'''Dark Jedi robes''' were the typical [[Sith apparel|wear]] of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] aligned with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. The specific robes worn were broken down into two simple groups: those belonging to and worn by [[Dark Jedi robe|Dark Jedi Knights]], and those to and by [[Dark Jedi Master robe|Masters]].

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Despite being referred to as "Dark Jedi robes," players could equip their characters with these robes in both games of the ''Knights of the Old Republic'' series, regardless of their alignment. The Dark Jedi robes of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic|first Knights of the Old Republic game]] resemble [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] black Jedi robe in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].
